enrichment.summary: This changes an agreement with a San Francisco consultant who documents meetings of the district's School Safety Design teams, reviews best practices from other districts, and helps plan how to put the Safety Plan in place and how to measure its results. It adds $5,000.00, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $30,000.00 to $35,000.00, for September 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021. The Board is being asked to ratify, meaning approve it after the fact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Moira De Nike - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $20,000 for a facilitator to help design new school safety models without police
enrichment.summary: An Oakland contractor facilitates the Safety Plan design team, workgroups and listening sessions and supports follow-up paperwork for putting the plan in place. The plan is meant to provide new models of school safety without police. The agreement runs April 1 through June 30, 2021, for up to $20,000.00. The Board is being asked to ratify, meaning approve it after the fact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Gregory E Hodge - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Adds $3.57M and one year to the Fremont High construction contract for the library renovation
enrichment.summary: This addendum changes a facilities lease agreement with Cahill/Focon JV for the Library Renovation Project within the Fremont High School New Construction Project. It adds $3,568,980.00, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $95,301,226.00 to $98,870,206.00. It also extends the end date from December 31, 2020 to December 31, 2021, an added 365 days.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
